summary: I kept the three unequal kick accents and filled in the little drum strokes that answer between them. The exposed five-note phrase has a light reply on either side of the stressed G. The last two words fall away after the drums.

points.text: Listen for the small strokes between each pair of kicks.
The little answers return with the three-beat figure.
The quick syllables frame the G before the drop.
The last three kicks keep their rising accents, then the two words answer quietly.
